adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb`, `update` and `destroy` fetch with `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and do not handle the `nil` case. `update` then calls `save_host(host)` where `save_host` immediately does `host.host = ...`, which will raise `NoMethodError` if the record wasn't found. `destroy` does `host.destroy` with the same risk. Additionally, `save_host` assumes `params[:embeddable_host]` is present and a hash (`params[:embeddable_host][:host]`, `[:category_id]`), which will also raise if the nested param is missing/malformed. These are concrete 500-error paths visible in the diff.
